verdict.rationale: Canny's native integrations let a PM send a feedback item to Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, or Asana, link it to existing issues or tasks, and sync statuses. That turns feedback into actionable work items in task tools, and MCP lets agents act on feedback and draft PRDs. However, the evidence is one-line marketing copy, the Jira path is limited to Jira Cloud, and nothing shows how a new task is created or what fields carry over. missing for 10: detailed docs on creating new tasks/projects from a submission (field mapping, workflow), native in-Canny task or project creation, Jira Server/Data Center support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can turn a customer feedback submission directly into an actionable task or project intention
